name: Hellwrath adds 5 Demon's Blood stacks and 1% Black Shield absorption per stack (#1130)
contract: #1130: Hellwrath 804014 (family 23, CharacterAdvancement 30125, class 17 Defiance tab) reads 'Your Demon's Blood can now stack $s1 additional times and each stack now increases the absorption amount of Black Shield by $s2%' with $s1 = 5 and $s2 = 1. Black Shield 805679 reads 'Consume all of your Demon's Blood stacks to create a demonic shield that absorbs ${$805680m1+$805680ppl1} damage, increased by $800999s3% per Demon's Blood stack'; Demon's Blood 800999 effect 2 is +20 (BasePoints 19 + DieSides 1), so each consumed stack adds 20% of the base absorb, and with Hellwrath each stack adds 20% + 1% = 21%. Effect 0 of Hellwrath is the native aura 107 SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS +5 with mask (0x20000000, 0, 0x10); Demon's Blood 800999 carries family flags (0, 0, 0x10) and StackAmount 10, so SpellInfo::CalcMaxAuraStacks reads 15 natively. Effect 1 is SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +1 on mask (0x20000000, 0, 0), which only matches the helper 520298 'Demon's Blood SLS2' that nothing applies, while Black Shield's absorb is computed by aura_ascension_xoroth_lifecycle::Calculate as amount * (1 + 0.2 * consumed stacks); before the fix Hellwrath never reached it. Black Shield has no Rage cost and requires Demon's Blood (CasterAuraSpell 800999); its 120 s cooldown is reset between casts and each shield is removed before the next cast so every absorb is freshly calculated. Expected: with 10 consumed stacks the talented shield is 3.1/3.0 = 1.0333 times the untalented one (1.0000 before the fix), and with the 15 stacks Hellwrath allows it is 4.15/3.0 = 1.3833 times.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: Demon's Blood's base cap is 10 stacks
Ten Demon's Blood stacks for the untalented shield
Black Shield without Hellwrath
SETUP: the untalented Black Shield is up
SETUP: Black Shield consumed every Demon's Blood stack
Untalented absorb with 10 consumed stacks
SETUP: the untalented shield absorbs something
Remove the first shield so the next one is freshly calculated
Force the Hellwrath passive aura
Let the passive's modifiers settle
SETUP: the Hellwrath passive is active
CONTRACT: Demon's Blood can stack 5 additional times (10 -> 15)
The same ten stacks for the talented shield
Black Shield with Hellwrath, 10 stacks
SETUP: the talented Black Shield is up
CONTRACT: each of the 10 stacks adds 21% instead of 20% (3.1 / 3.0)
Remove the second shield
Fill Demon's Blood to the talented cap
CONTRACT: Demon's Blood holds 15 stacks
Black Shield with Hellwrath, 15 stacks
SETUP: the 15-stack Black Shield is up
CONTRACT: 15 stacks at 21% each give 4.15 / 3.0 of the untalented 10-stack shield
